💼 Sales

How to put Online Sales Shopify orders in Odoo

1
Login to google account of ahoogahouse.1050.be@gmail.com - by now you should have already access to the gmail account on google chrome
2
Click the following link from the google chrome with Ahooga House as user access: https://accounts.shopify.com/select?rid=210d88ec-dc52-475e-aed5-2fbba480b774
3
Access the account with Username: ahoogahouse.1050.be@gmail.com
4
You will have now all the list of orders of shopify, each with a number of 4 digits, the date of the order, customer name, etc (see below)
5
Open another TAB now in your browser and access odoo.
6
Go in the Sales App
7
Go in the navigation bar where you put the filters
8
Click on Favorites > All Sales.
9
You will now see the list of all sales order in the Sales Team Online. Sales Team online means that are orders that arrived from Online (it can be from the chat in the website through our Customer service, from a ticket in our aftersales service, or from our webshop – Shopify ).

In the example above the last order from Shopify is S21981 of Sarah Delgado Sedano.

10
You now know that the last order input in odoo from Shopify is the one of Sarah Delgado.
11
Go back now to the shopify order page. If there are new orders in shopify you have to input them in odoo. In the example below of course Sarah Delgado is the last one since we have not received any new orders in the meantime while I am writing this procedure.
12
Let’s imagine that the last order in Odoo was the one of Marion Gnutzmann and you want now to input in odoo the one of Sarah Delgado Sedano.
13
Click on the order number associated to that order #8392. A new page will open. That is the order page as below.
14
In the order you can find all the information you need to input in Odoo.
15
Check at first if pick up location is at dealer: if it is at dealer please move to this procedure: How to Handle Online Sales orders with Pick-up at a dealer.docx
16
Go back to Odoo Sales App > Click “NEW”
17
Please be careful to input the info in the correct order because it will influence the fiscal position, the taxes declaration and the product prices.
18
In the new window fill in all the customer info that you can find in the Shopify Sales order like in the picture below in the blue area:
19
After filling the information in Odoo you can click “SAVE & CLOSE”
⚠️ NOTE: Imagine that Sarah Delgado was a company, in that case you need to click on “company” and add a “VAT number”.
20
Make sure the pricelist is set on the order on “Public Pricelist”. Based on the pricelist prices of the products might change in Odoo and needs to be verified at the last step of the sales order.
21
Also, inputting a company and VAT number will influence the price of the products and the taxes so be careful.
22
Let’s go back now after clicking “SAVE & CLOSE” this page will appear:
23
Go now to “Other Info”. You will have now to modify or fill in those 5 items (also fiscal position that is not rounded in the picture).
24
Sales Team: make sure is set on “Online”
25
Customer reference: Make sure to write the Shopify Sales order number. In this case is #8392.
26
Fiscal position: remove for the time being any fiscal position. Let it blank like this the pricelist – that should be set on “public pricelist” will set the correct prices in the order.
27
Tags: Select “Shopify”
28
Tags: Select as well the tag of the type of bike : “A-MAX”, “E-MAX”, “Power+”, “MOD Low”, “MOD Uni”. Note: you can add as many tag as you want in the tag section.
29
Warehouse – be carefull wrong warehouse will trigger problems in Supply Team:

Here you need to select or “ahooga Anderlecht” or “Louise”. How to choose?

You need to select Louise for all orders where the pick up location is set as Ahooga Bruxelles. Like in the picture below:

You need to select “Ahooga Anderlecht” for all the other orders.

(Note: if it is a pickup at dealer, please check the procedure available at this link: How to Handle Online Sales orders with Pick-up at a dealer.docx )

By selecting “Louise” it means that the shipment will occur from Louise.

By selecting “Ahooga Anderlecht” It means that the shipment will occur from Anderlecht.

Back to the example we were doing this is how it should be filled in:

30
You can now add the products in “order lines”.
31
Click on Add product and add all the product there are in the shopify orders.

Click “Add a note” and write “Paid via Shopify on DD/MM” where DD means day and MM means month. This will allow Supply team to know that the order is already been paid. You can see if it is paid or not in Shopify. If Shopify shows still in “Payment pending” do not confirm the sales order.

⚠️ IMPORTANT!!!
32
In Shopify commercial discounts are integrated immediately in the products, in Odoo they are NOT. You need to add a line call “commercial discount” and add in the unit price a negative amount to have a reduction of the price.
33
Add Shipping if in shopify there was a shipping included. Please double check that the price is the same between Odoo and Shopify. If NOT, modify the shipping price MANUALLY.
34
Now go Back to “Other info” and put in Fiscal position the correct Fiscal Position either:
35
EU prive / Regime National if it is a Sales Order in Belgium
36
OSS B2C Germany – if it is a sales order for a german client
37
OSS B2C France – if it is a sales order for a client in France
38
OSS B2C Netherland - if it is a sales order for a client in Netherlands...
39
Etc etc
40
Then Click “Update Taxes” - this will set the correct VAT in the sales order.
41
Now go back to “Order Lines” At the end of the order please compare the total price of the sales order in odoo and the total price of the order in Shopify. Odoo order must match Shopify order because client paid what Shopify told the client to pay. If total is not matching please re-check the prices in Odoo and modify them manually. Re-check the total again if it is matching with Shopify. NEVER CONFIRM AN ODOO ORDER IF NOT MATCHING WITH SHOPIFY.
📧 Confirmation email sent to customer (Odoo template)

Dear Customer,

Thank you for your order.

Our team is currently preparing your parcel and will proceed with shipping as soon as possible.

Should you have any questions in the meantime, please do not hesitate to contact us at hello@ahooga.bike

Kind regards,
Ahooga Team

42
If the shipment was at a retailer ( Just as reminder : which also means that you have selected warehouse “Ahooga Anderlecht”) like in this example below, you need to change the deliver address of the sales order EVEN though the customer name remains “Sarah Delgado”. This will allow the order to be shipped to the retailer but invoiced to the client.
43
If this is the case, you need to @arthur and the @salesperson responsible for that retailer to inform the retailer that we will ship a shopify order to them for a specific client. This will also result in a credit note to the dealer for the service. (credit note = value of their normal margin for the shipped product).
44
You CAN NOW DO THE NEXT SHOPIFY ORDER!!!!
